reviews.feedback: internal/store/types.go (~line 252): PreviousSecret is tagged json:"-" but the snapshot (internal/snapshot/snapshot.go:30, via store.Export in internal/store/state.go:22) persists WebhookEndpoints as JSON, so the previous secret is dropped on save and lost on restart (cmd/tally/main.go:35). Within 24h of a rotation, deliveries after a restart then carry only the new v1 entry, violating the two-entry requirement. Persist PreviousSecret in the snapshot state (e.g. a json tag or a separate persistence type) while keeping it out of API responses (the handlers in internal/api/webhooks.go write store.WebhookEndpoint directly, so use a view type or equivalent). Add a test that saves and loads via internal/snapshot and checks that a delivery within 24h of rotation still carries two v1 entries.
